mapper.select: SELECT account_row.account_id AS accountId, account_row.account_name AS productName, account_row.next_payment_date AS nextPaymentDate, latest_tx.in_amount AS expectedAmount FROM ACCOUNT account_row LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION latest_tx ON latest_tx.account_transaction_id = ( SELECT installment_row.account_transaction_id FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION installment_row WHERE installment_row.account_id = account_row.account_id AND installment_row.transaction_category = 'INSTALLMENT' ORDER BY installment_row.tran_date DESC, installment_row.tran_time DESC, installment_row.account_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_row.currency_code = 'KRW' AND account_row.deposit_type_code = '12'

SELECT account_row.account_id AS accountId, account_row.account_name AS productName, account_row.balance AS outstandingBalance, account_row.next_payment_date AS nextPaymentDate, latest_tx.out_amount AS expectedAmount, latest_tx.loan_principal_amount AS expectedPrincipalAmount, latest_tx.loan_interest_amount AS expectedInterestAmount FROM ACCOUNT account_row LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION latest_tx ON latest_tx.account_transaction_id = ( SELECT loan_row.account_transaction_id FROM ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION loan_row WHERE loan_row.account_id = account_row.account_id AND loan_row.transaction_category = 'LOAN' AND loan_row.out_amount > 0 AND () ORDER BY loan_row.tran_date DESC, loan_row.tran_time DESC, loan_row.account_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_row.currency_code = 'KRW' AND account_row.deposit_type_code = '40' AND account_row.account_group = 'LOAN'

SELECT account_row.account_id AS accountId, transaction_row.tran_date AS tranDate, transaction_row.out_amount AS outAmount, transaction_row.desc1, transaction_row.desc2, transaction_row.desc3, transaction_row.desc4 FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND account_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account_row.currency_code = 'KRW' AND account_row.deposit_type_code = '11' AND transaction_row.transaction_category = 'ORDINARY' AND transaction_row.out_amount > 0 AND transaction_row.tran_date BETWEEN #{observationStartDate} AND #{observationEndDate} ORDER BY account_row.account_id, transaction_row.tran_date
